sources.title: “气候特使”解振华 谈判桌上16年
sources.author: Huo Siyi / 霍思伊
sources.publication: China Newsweek / 中国新闻周刊, 2024 issue 2, total issue 1124, January 8, 2024
sources.source_type: Original reported profile with named participant interviews and reused earlier accounts, read in publisher-group and media reproductions
sources.reading_scope: All article sections read in overlapping Sina and China News Service captures, from COP28 opening through final Xie quote; substantive CNS text lines 313–385, especially 346–374. Reporter and issue credits checked. No underlying interview recordings, full transcripts or meeting minutes acquired.
decisive_locators: “将国际国内结合得非常好”: Zou Ji on research assigned in 2012.
“讲一个道理让各方都能接受”: post-Copenhagen review narrated by reporter; Zou explicitly quoted on Tianjin.
“他们能够认真倾听对方”: Zou on expert video meetings, overnight reporting and Xie's coordination.
sources.supports: Named retrospective Chinese participant testimony about preparation for 2014 provides a concrete possible narrative addition.
limits: Article is a sympathetic profile; interviews are edited and retrospectively recalled.
Post-Copenhagen review is narrated without a discrete source citation; do not present it as an authenticated meeting record.
No-public-blame rules are narrated with Zou's subsequent endorsement; exact inception and consistent observance unproved.
Copenhagen dramatic scene attributes recollection to Stern, so is not independent Chinese corroboration.
The 2020 NDC wording should not substitute for the original 2014/2015 target dates.
Website metadata names editor Shao Wanyun; the article body names reporter Huo Siyi.
Sina, CNS and Tsinghua republications are one reporting chain.
